summary: A reminder this member closes with a local mark hands its place on the client messages open page to the group's previous version, also for a reader whose page is pinned to an earlier cut while the selector fold catches up. Before this, if a later version of the group had already folded past that cut, the pinned page showed no member of the group until the cut published

replay.detail: No claim or projection replay. The open page at a pinned cut picks the stand-in when it reads; nothing is written.

schema.detail: No table, index or schema change; the page uses the existing retired-cut and reminder-candidate indexes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest change; marks and selectors stay outside every digest.

compatibility.detail: Mixed-version fleets are unaffected: marks and selectors are member-local, and the member that holds them serves the page; no wire or stored-format change.
